fields.features_heading: What Runs Inside a WhatsApp Automation
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the workflow, its contact database and a dashboard from one prompt, tied to your business number.
fields.feature_1:
Sends a template when an event fires

Connects to your WhatsApp business number through its API. A shipped order or a new booking starts the run, and the app sends the approved template with the customer's details in it.
fields.feature_2:
Replies from your own records

Reads the question, looks up the order or booking in your database, and answers with its real status while the customer service window is open. Each reply is logged on the contact.
fields.feature_3:
Hands the hard chats to a person

You name the topics a person must take, such as refunds or complaints. The app stops replying on those, sends the chat to a teammate by Slack direct message, and keeps the thread.
fields.feature_4:
Asks one question per message

Runs a short question flow inside the chat: one question, wait for the answer, then the next. Each answer is saved to its own field on the lead, so a later rule can act on it.
fields.feature_5:
Keeps opt-in on every contact

Stores where and when each contact opted in, and checks that record before any template goes out. Every message and reply sits in a database you own, with no cap on tasks.
fields.feature_6:
Your WhatsApp app's code, in GitHub

Exports the full code to your GitHub repository on paid plans. A developer can read every template call and routing rule, and point the app at another tool through its API.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Customer Chats to Automate First
fields.tab_content_1:
As soon as a box ships, its tracking number follows

When Lanternwick Candle Co. marks order #20417 shipped, the app sends Maren Blackwyn the approved shipping template with tracking number LW-58302. She ticked the WhatsApp opt-in box at checkout, and the app checks that record first. Her replies land in the support inbox with the order attached.
fields.tab_content_2:
Reply 2 and a new time is one tap away

Every booking at Spokewright Cycle Repair gets a reminder template 24 hours before the service: reply 1 to confirm or 2 to change. When a customer replies 2, the app sends the booking page and opens the slot. Osric Harrowell replies 2 about his Thursday 10:30 AM tune-up, and that slot is back on the shop calendar.
fields.tab_content_3:
Refund chats reach a person with hours to spare

Pebblecourt Pet Supply's support inbox fills up on Monday mornings. The app answers order-status questions from the order table. Any chat about a refund goes to support lead Wilhelmina Tarr by Slack direct message. Chats with under 2 hours left in the 24-hour window move to the top of her inbox.
fields.tab_content_4:
Under 30 days to move means a call today

A buyer taps the WhatsApp button on a Wrenfold Realty listing, and the app asks for a move-in date, then the bedroom count. Thessaly Brandauer plans to move within 3 weeks and needs 3 bedrooms. Any move within 30 days goes to agent Junia Fenwright by Slack direct message, with a note to call that day.

fields.howto_description: Seven steps to set up WhatsApp automation for one customer conversation, test it on your own number, then add the next.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick the chat your team types most
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Record opt-in where numbers come in
fields.howto_step_1_des: Count a normal week of WhatsApp messages and sort them by what they are about: order status, bookings, refunds, new leads. Start with the conversation your team answers by hand most often, because it pays back first and shows where replies need a person.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Give the app access to your WhatsApp business phone number through its API, along with the order system or booking calendar it will read. Use a number apart from anyone's personal phone, and the whole team sees the same threads.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Draft each message the app will start on its own, such as a shipping update or a reminder, with fields for the name and order number. Submit them early: once the 24-hour window closes, only pre-approved templates can go out.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Add a WhatsApp opt-in checkbox wherever you collect phone numbers: checkout, the booking page, a listing inquiry. Save the time and the source of each opt-in on the contact, and have the app check it before any template goes out.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the workflow in a prompt
fields.howto_step_5_des: Tell Emergent the trigger, the template, the questions the app answers on its own, and the topics that go to a person. Emergent builds the workflow, the contact database, and an inbox screen, and you change any rule later by prompting.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Test it on your own phone
fields.howto_step_6_des: Opt in with a teammate's number and run the whole conversation: trigger the template, reply with each option, ask a refund question. Check that every message lands on the right contact and that the hand-off reaches the person you named.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Watch the inbox for two weeks
fields.howto_step_7_des: Read the chats the app passed to a person and the ones it answered. Where the app handed off a question it could have answered from your records, add that rule by prompting, then move on to the next conversation on your list.

faq_plan.a: WhatsApp automation is software that sends, answers, or routes WhatsApp messages for a business when something happens, instead of a person typing each one. A shipped order can trigger a tracking update, a booking can trigger a reminder, and a question about an order can get its status from your records.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up WhatsApp automation?
faq_plan.a: Pick one conversation, connect the business phone number to the WhatsApp API, and get your templates approved. Then describe the trigger, the message, and who takes the hard replies to Emergent's AI automation builder. Emergent builds the workflow and its contact database, and you try it with your own opted-in number before customers see it.

Partly. The WhatsApp Business app is free to download, and its greeting and away messages handle simple auto-replies. On the WhatsApp Business Platform, Meta charges on a per-message basis for what a business sends. Meta does not charge for messages from users to businesses, and each business number gets 1,000 delivered service messages free per month.

faq_plan.q: Can I use WhatsApp automation for messages to my own team?
faq_plan.a: Yes, as long as each teammate has opted in on their own number. Shift reminders and a short check-in after a training course work the same way as customer messages. For the check-in, borrow wording from a set of learning and development survey questions and send one per message. The app Emergent builds saves each answer to a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How does the 24-hour window affect WhatsApp automation?
faq_plan.a: It decides what the automation is allowed to send. When a contact messages your business, a 24-hour customer service window starts. After it closes, the business can only send pre-approved template messages. Plan for both cases: replies while the window is open, and templates for anything later, such as a reminder sent days after the last chat.

faq_plan.q: Does WhatsApp automation need opt-in from every contact?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Meta's rules say a business can only send messages to WhatsApp users who have opted in to receiving messages from it. Ask at the point where you collect the number, in words that name WhatsApp, and keep the record. Give opt-in its own checkbox rather than folding it into your terms.

faq_plan.q: Can a WhatsApp automation bot run a quiz or a poll?
faq_plan.a: Yes. A WhatsApp automation bot can send a question and score the reply before it sends the next. That suits a trivia night or a quick product poll. Number the options so contacts reply with a digit. A set of game survey questions makes a good warm-up round. Emergent builds the question flow and its scoring from one prompt.

faq_plan.q: Can WhatsApp automation hand a chat over to a person?
faq_plan.a: Yes. You list the topics a person must handle, and the app stops answering those chats and alerts a teammate. Send a short holding reply first, such as a note that a person will answer within the hour. The teammate then answers from the same business number, and the thread stays in one place.

faq_plan.q: What does WhatsApp automation through the API add over the free app?
faq_plan.a: The free app sends greeting messages and away messages, which suit a small shop answering by hand. Through the API, an app can send a message the moment an order ships and answer from your order records. Move to the API once the same questions arrive every day.

faq_plan.q: How can WhatsApp automation ask contacts what they want before a launch?
faq_plan.a: Send a short template to contacts who opted in, then ask two or three questions one message at a time and save each answer on the contact. Ask about timing and price before features. A list of audience survey questions gives you wording to start from. Emergent builds the flow and a live dashboard that counts answers as they arrive.
